response.rationale: C1 is favored because recurrent exudative lymphocytic effusions began after starting RIPE, serum ANA is positive with a speckled pattern, and low pleural complement supports immune-mediated lupus pleuritis. AFB-positive organism and negative cultures are incompatible with sarcoidosis; VATS biopsy showed no granulomata; ANA and low complement favor lupus.
